name: voice-bot
description: AI interview voice bot — root scripts for Docker workflows

scripts.images:export: mkdir -p images && docker save ai-interview-backend:latest -o images/ai-interview-backend.tar && docker save ai-interview-frontend:latest -o images/ai-interview-frontend.tar && ls -lh images/*.tar
scripts.images:selfhost: docker load -i images/ai-interview-backend.tar && docker load -i images/ai-interview-frontend.tar && docker compose -f docker-compose.selfhost.yml up -d
